hash_field_change.description: Foreman blanked by an archived-WR lookup formula (mem04_blank_lookup scenario) -- 'foreman_observed' is a HASH_FIELDS member, so this MUST produce a different content_hash and drive a group_state repair for its (wr, week_ending) group.

non_hash_field_change.description: A formula-only edit to a column pipeline_memory never maps into HASH_FIELDS (e.g. a display-only 'Customer Name' lookup, mem04_edit_mapping scenario's sibling case) -- MUST produce the SAME content_hash and NO group_state repair. This is correct, not a miss: only billing-relevant columns participate in the hash.
